_comment: Microsoft -> Odoo 5-year comparison (flywheel SPEC-022). Single source of rules for src/utils/mscalc.ts and the Python twin backend/libs/mscalc.py (parity cases tests/cases/mscalc_cases.json, T-MSC-0xx), vendored into mauxy by scripts/sync_selfcheck.py. Owner decision 2026-11-10 (D-065): the page shows NO computed prices; the visitor enters the figures in the embedded Selbst-Check (stay stage, field map 'selfcheck' below), mauxy computes the comparison after the double opt-in and mails it. Every rate is a named assumption with a source and a status: verified = list price read on the official page (url + accessed), owner_to_confirm = Simplify-ERP placeholder (keeps /microsoft-to-odoo held, T-MSC-060, and keeps every figure out of the customer mail, T-MSC-080..), neutral = calculation default. Customer mail figures only when customer_mail_figures is true AND no rate is owner_to_confirm. EUR, net (zzgl. MwSt.).

selfcheck._comment: Embedded Selbst-Check (selfcheck.json): the comparison applies when the answer 'system' has system_option. fields: stay field of the Selbst-Check -> calculator input; missing 'zero' = 0, 'default' = the input's default (cautious estimate when the visitor leaves it empty). Labels of the fields = the inputs' labels below.

mail._comment: Result mail block (mauxy, contact's language) and operator / CRM line (English). {placeholders} are filled server-side from the engine result only. pending = the neutral sentence while the gate is closed.
